summary: Asked where a group has been together lately, Nora reads the computed outings directly instead of piecing them together from the chat history.
details: `rollup_read` is now offered on a person's tag turn, under the same per-room lineage the Cognition session reads it with; fire turns, sub-agent workers and Dreamer adaptors still do not get it.
limitations: Only rows of the current Rollup build are read, so an outing from the last few hours may not be there yet.
